SELECT
    typeof(res.milliseconds) AS milliseconds_type,
    typeof(res.time) AS time_type,
    COUNT(*) AS winner_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS races,
    MIN(res.milliseconds) AS min_milliseconds,
    MAX(res.milliseconds) AS max_milliseconds,
    MIN(res.time) AS min_time,
    MAX(res.time) AS max_time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder = 1 AND res.position = 1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS position_disagreements
FROM main.races AS r
JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND (res.position = 1 OR res.positionOrder = 1)
GROUP BY typeof(res.milliseconds), typeof(res.time)

arguments.sql:
WITH winners AS (
    SELECT r.year, r.raceId, r.name, res.driverId, res.position, res.positionOrder,
           res.time, res.milliseconds, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY r.raceId) AS winner_rows
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1
)
SELECT year, raceId, name, driverId, position, positionOrder, time, milliseconds
FROM winners
WHERE winner_rows > 1
ORDER BY year, raceId, driverId

arguments.sql:
WITH race_winner_times AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds
    FROM main.races AS r
    JOIN main.results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.position = 1
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
),
yearly_totals AS (
    SELECT year, SUM(milliseconds) AS total_ms, COUNT(*) AS race_count
    FROM race_winner_times
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT
    year,
    ((total_ms + 5 * race_count) / (10 * race_count)) / 100.0
        AS mean_winner_elapsed_seconds
FROM yearly_totals
ORDER BY year
LIMIT -1
